Crown Dominion™

12-Month Results Challenge Participant Agreement

Salon Studio 21™ | A Brand of Duyen An LLC

Draft form preview. This should connect to private storage/signature handling before collecting sensitive client information online.

Participant

1. Program

Crown Dominion™ is an independent 12-month Studio 21™ client results program using a Nioxin® full-size 3-product home-care system. The program is designed to encourage consistent use and document visible progress under reasonably consistent salon photography conditions. Nioxin® and Wella Company are not sponsors or partners of this independent program.

2. Participation Commitment

I agree to participate for 12 consecutive months and make a reasonable effort to follow the recommended home-care instructions consistently. I understand that individual results vary and that no specific hair-growth, density, scalp, or cosmetic result is promised or guaranteed.

3. Payment & Secure Autopay

I authorize Salon Studio 21™ to charge the payment method on file $20 per month for 12 consecutive months, for a total scheduled program cost of $240. A valid payment method must remain on file for the duration of the program. If a payment method expires or is declined, I agree to update it so my participation can remain current.

4. Home-Care Product

Full-size home-care kits will be supplied according to the program schedule and actual usage. Product longevity varies with hair length, density, frequency of washing, and amount used. Any unused prepaid product or other prepaid program amount, if applicable, will be reconciled according to the written program terms and applicable law.

5. Progress Photography

I agree to progress photographs during the program. Studio 21™ may use consistent angles, lighting, cropping, labels, arrangements, or side-by-side comparisons for documentation. Images will not be altered to exaggerate results.

6. Privacy & Results Use

Finalist voting will be anonymous. With the permission selected below, Studio 21™ may use anonymous progress images and results in advertising, social media, websites, print, education, presentations, promotional materials, and professional discussions, including sharing anonymous study/results material with professional hair-care companies. My identifying or contact information will not be released to a third party without separate permission.

Anonymous photo/results permission
Permission to identify me publicly

7. Contest Eligibility & Voting

Final contest eligibility requires completion of the program requirements. Studio 21™ clients will vote anonymously based on visible documented results. Family/friend voting and campaigning are not permitted. Studio 21™ may disqualify votes or participation that do not follow the published challenge rules.

8. Prizes & Dates

Enrollment deadline: October 1, 2026. Client voting is planned for October 2027. Winner announcement is planned for November 1, 2027. The Top 5 finalists receive 50% off their next kit. The grand-prize winner receives another full year of Crown Dominion™ home care complimentary, subject to the final published prize terms.

9. Acknowledgment

By signing below, I confirm that I have read and understand this agreement, including the 12-month commitment, recurring payment authorization, photography requirements, privacy choices, contest rules, and the fact that results are not guaranteed.

Who will reign supreme? Your commitment. Your results. Your crown.
